about.title: What is Biasmarket?
about.subtitle: Meet the story behind the market made by fans, for fans
about.helpTitle: Any questions? Find the answers here.

items.title: A community made by fans
items.body: Bias Market was born from the K-pop fandom. We connect group orders and stores that understand exactly what you're looking for: albums, photocards, official merch and limited editions.

items.title: Support independent sellers
items.body: Every store on Bias Market is run by a fan just like you. No giant warehouses or cold middlemen — just passionate people selling what they love.

items.title: Buy with peace of mind
items.body: Payments with Yape, Plin and more. Order tracking at every step and real support if something goes wrong. Your bias merch is in good hands.

items.question: Do I need a payment gateway?
items.answer: No — buyers upload their proof of payment manually. Bank transfer, Wise, PayPal, whatever you already use.

items.question: Can I sell only photocards, not full group orders?
items.answer: Yes — Bias Market works for album group orders, individual photocard claims, set splits and fan-made merch drops.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Free for early sellers while we keep building the product.
